metadata.description: Project name (also Container App name).
Azure region.
Region for RAG resources (Search, Storage, embeddings). Defaults to location. Set to a different region if location is at capacity for AI Search basic tier.
Stage label baked into env vars (dev / prod).
ACR name (globally unique). Used only when provisioning a new ACR (existingAcrName empty).
Container App Environment name. Used only when provisioning a new env (existingContainerAppEnvName empty).
Log Analytics workspace name.
User-assigned managed identity name.
Key Vault name (globally unique, 3-24 chars, alphanumeric + dashes, must start with a letter). Empty derives a deterministic name from projectName + a hash of the RG ID.
Expose the OpenAPI JSON spec at /openapi.json on the deployed app (defaults off; flip on for environments onboarded to URSA Web Scanner).

Image reference appended to the ACR login server. Accepts tag form ("__PROJECT_NAME__:0.1.0-abc123") or digest form ("__PROJECT_NAME__@sha256:..."). deploy.js prefers digest form so Container App revisions are pinned to immutable images for rollback.

Resolved image digest ("sha256:..."), surfaced to the running container as IMAGE_DIGEST so /api/health can report the immutable byte identity of the deployed image. Empty when the caller cannot resolve a digest (e.g. internal ADO path that bypasses deploy.js).
Optional second MSAL client ID (e.g. for a partner / tribe tenant). Empty to skip.
Optional second MSAL tenant ID (e.g. for a partner / tribe tenant). Empty to skip.
Voice Live mode: create | existing
Cognitive Services account name (globally unique). Used only when voiceLiveMode=create.
Existing Voice Live endpoint (required if voiceLiveMode=existing).
Voice Live model.

Voice Live model version. Pinned to a known-good value because some regions (e.g. Sweden Central) reject deployments when version is null. Set to empty string only if a region accepts a null version for this model.

Standard Azure voice used by both the live Voice Live session and the pre-generated filler/nudge/greeting audio. Picked in the setup wizard. Format: <locale>-<name>:<model> (e.g. en-US-Andrew:DragonHDLatestNeural). Browse the catalog at https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/speech-service/language-support?tabs=tts.
Voice Live API key. Required when voiceLiveAuthMode=key. Ignored (but still safe to pass) when voiceLiveAuthMode=mi.

Voice Live auth mode. "key" uses the API key (legacy). "mi" uses Microsoft Entra: the Container App's UAMI is granted Cognitive Services User on the account and the backend authenticates with a Bearer token.

Existing Voice Live account name. Required when voiceLiveMode=existing AND voiceLiveAuthMode=mi (so we can grant the role on the right account). Ignored when voiceLiveMode=create (the new account name is used).
Resource group of the existing Voice Live account. Defaults to current RG. Set this when the account lives in a different RG (e.g. shared `__OPENAI_ACCOUNT_NAME__` in `__PROJECT_NAME__-rg`).

Optional override for the Voice Live private endpoint name. Used to coexist with a legacy hand-created PE that already occupies the default name (projectName + "-voicelive-pe") — Azure refuses CannotChangePrivateLinkConnectionOnPrivateEndpoint on an in-place retarget, so the new PE picks a distinct name and the legacy one is left alone as a rollback fallback. Leave empty to use the default name that matches the other PEs in this template.

Azure region for the Voice Live (gpt-realtime) Cognitive Services account. Defaults to the main deployment location. Set to a different region (e.g. "eastus2") when the gpt-realtime model is unavailable or at capacity in the primary region. Only used when voiceLiveMode=create.
Existing ACR name. When set, skip provisioning ACR and grant AcrPull on this registry instead. Pair with existingAcrResourceGroup when it lives in a different RG.
Resource group of the existing ACR. Defaults to current RG when existingAcrName is set but this is empty.
Existing Container App Environment name. When set, skip provisioning env and reuse this one.
Resource group of the existing Container App Environment. Defaults to current RG.
Feature toggles. Drives conditional module inclusion.
Custom domain name (only used when features.customDomain).
Existing managed cert name in the ACA env for the custom domain.

Azure Personal Voice Speaker Profile ID (GUID). Only used when features.customVoice. Surfaced to the Container App as AZURE_PERSONAL_VOICE_PROFILE_ID; the backend reads it in app/config.py and surfaces it to the frontend via /api/voice-config, which switches the Voice Live session to the azure-personal voice schema. Leave empty to keep the standard voice (e.g. while waiting for Personal Voice access to be approved).
AI Search service name (only used when features.rag). Globally unique.
RAG storage account name (only used when features.rag). 3-24 lowercase, globally unique.
RAG blob container name. Users drop docs here.

Additional IPv4 addresses (or CIDR ranges) allow-listed on the RAG storage account network ACL when features.rag and networkConfig.enabled. Use this to grant team-member workstations upload access. Survives redeploys (out-of-band `az storage account network-rule add` would otherwise be wiped on each bicep run).
Embeddings OpenAI account name (only used when features.rag and no existing endpoint provided). Globally unique.
Embedding model. Default text-embedding-3-large (3072 dims).
Existing embeddings endpoint (e.g. https://my-ai.cognitiveservices.azure.com). When set, skip creating a new account — reuses an existing AIServices account.
Existing embeddings deployment name on the existing account.

Direct AI Search endpoint. When set, skip provisioning Search and wire this endpoint into the Container App env vars. Used when reusing a pre-existing Search service (e.g. a shared one owned by a platform team).
AI Search index name (used regardless of feature.rag mode).
AI Search semantic config name. Empty disables semantic search.
Object ID of the user/SP running this deploy. When set, granted role assignments where applicable so the human can use the portal Data Explorer (Cosmos), upload PDFs (RAG storage), etc.
Principal type of deployerObjectId.

Network configuration. Controls VNet provisioning and private-endpoint wiring.

Create mode (default):
  {
    enabled: true,
    addressSpace: "10.20.0.0/16",          // VNet CIDR
    subnets: {
      aca: "10.20.0.0/27",                // ACA env subnet (min /27, delegated to Microsoft.App/environments)
      privateEndpoints: "10.20.1.0/24"   // PE NIC subnet
    },
    deployerIpAddress: "<your-ip>"
  }

BYON mode (Bring Your Own Network — pair with a pre-existing VNet):
  {
    enabled: true,
    existingVnetName: "my-hub-vnet",
    existingVnetResourceGroup: "networking-rg",  // optional, defaults to current RG
    existingAcaSubnetName: "aca-subnet",         // optional, defaults to "aca-subnet"
    existingPeSubnetName: "pe-subnet",           // optional, defaults to "pe-subnet"
    deployerIpAddress: "<your-ip>"
  }
  When existingVnetName is set, VNet and subnet creation is skipped.
  The named subnets must already exist and be correctly configured
  (ACA subnet delegated to Microsoft.App/environments; PE subnet with
  privateEndpointNetworkPolicies disabled).
  Private DNS zones are still provisioned in the current RG and linked
  to the existing VNet so that private-endpoint A records resolve.

Pass-2-only flag. When true (and networkConfig.enabled), flips ACR to publicNetworkAccess: Disabled. The ACR PE is already wired in pass 1 so the Container App's image pull goes through the private endpoint. Has no effect when networkConfig.enabled is false.

Pass-2-only flag. When true (and networkConfig.enabled + features.rag), flips AI Search to publicNetworkAccess: Disabled. The Search PE is already wired in pass 1, and indexer setup has already run via the deployer-IP firewall window. Has no effect when networkConfig.enabled or features.rag is false.

Pass-2-only flag. When true (and networkConfig.enabled + features.rag), flips the RAG storage account to publicNetworkAccess: Disabled. The blob PE is already wired in pass 1 and the AI Search indexer reaches storage via the Search-managed shared private link. IP rules are cleared automatically — they are incompatible with publicNetworkAccess: Disabled. Has no effect when networkConfig.enabled or features.rag is false.
Whether to deploy the Container App. False on the first pass (before the image exists in ACR), true on the second pass.
First line the agent says.
Path inside the container to the system prompt file.
Path inside the container to the knowledge base JSON file.
Path inside the container to the partners registry JSON.
Cosmos DB account name (only used when features.transcripts).
Cosmos DB database name for transcripts.
Cosmos DB container name for transcripts.
Default TTL in seconds for transcript docs. -1 disables auto-expire.
Per-deployment salt used to hash user identifiers before storing transcripts.
VNet name. Used only in create mode (existingVnetName empty).
Azure region.
VNet address space CIDR. Used only in create mode.
Subnet CIDR for the ACA workload-profiles environment. Min /27. Delegated to Microsoft.App/environments. Used only in create mode.
Subnet CIDR for private endpoint NICs. Used only in create mode.
Name of an existing VNet to reuse. When set, VNet and subnet creation is skipped and the existing VNet is used instead (BYON mode).
Resource group of the existing VNet. Defaults to the current resource group when existingVnetName is set but this is empty.
Name of the existing ACA subnet (must be delegated to Microsoft.App/environments) inside the existing VNet.
Name of the existing private-endpoint subnet (must have privateEndpointNetworkPolicies disabled) inside the existing VNet.
When true, reuse an existing shared private DNS set in the target resource group instead of creating new private DNS zones here.
Resource group containing the existing private DNS zones. Defaults to the current resource group when useExistingDnsZones is true and this is empty.
Log Analytics workspace name.
Azure region.
Name of the existing Log Analytics workspace to attach the transformation to.
Full resource ID of the Log Analytics workspace (destination of the DCR).
Azure region — must match the workspace region.
Name of the workspace transformation DCR resource.

metadata.description: ACR name. Must be globally unique, alphanumeric, 5-50 chars.
Azure region.

Network mode flag. When true, the ACR is provisioned with the Premium SKU (required for private endpoints) and may be locked down per `lockdown`. When false, behaves like the legacy default (Basic, publicNetworkAccess Enabled). PE itself is created out-of-band in main.bicep via the generic private-endpoint module.

Pass-2-only lockdown flag. Ignored when networkEnabled is false. When true and networkEnabled is true, sets publicNetworkAccess: Disabled. When false (pass 1), leaves ACR fully publicly accessible so `az acr build` can push images without dealing with ACR Tasks firewall edge cases.

Application Insights connection string. Empty value skips secret creation.

UAMI principal ID to grant Key Vault Secrets User to.
ACR name in the target RG.
UAMI principal ID to grant AcrPull to.

Azure region.

Connection string used by the backend OTel distro.

Azure region.
Log Analytics customer ID.

Application Insights connection string. Empty disables AI-side telemetry forwarding for this env.

VNet subnet ID for ACA infrastructure (workload-profiles env egress). When non-empty, switches the env to workload profiles + vnetConfiguration so outbound traffic routes through this subnet. Public ingress is preserved (internal: false). When empty, deploys a Consumption-only env without VNet integration (current default behavior).
Cognitive Services account name. Globally unique.
Azure region.
Realtime model to deploy.

Specific model version. Pinned to a known-good value because some regions (e.g. Sweden Central) reject deployments when version is null. Set to empty string to fall back to the Azure default (do this only if you know the region accepts a null version for this model).
Deployment capacity (units; varies by model).
Network mode flag. When true, publicNetworkAccess is Disabled so the only data-plane path is via the private endpoint provisioned in main.bicep.
Cognitive Services / AIServices account name (Voice Live account) in the target RG.
UAMI principal ID to grant Cognitive Services User to.
Search service name. Globally unique, 2-60 chars, lowercase.
Azure region.
SKU: free, basic, standard, ...

Network mode flag. When true, the Search service stays publicly accessible BUT the firewall is restricted to the supplied deployer IP. (PNA: enabled + ipRules) — required during indexer configuration because deploy.js PUTs the indexer / datasource / skillset via the public REST endpoint from the deployer's machine. After configureSearchIndexer runs, deploy.js re-deploys with searchLockdown=true to flip PNA to Disabled.
Deployer public IP (IPv4) added to the firewall when networkEnabled is true. Empty disables the IP rule, which will lock the deployer out of the data plane.

PR 3 pass-2 flag: when true, flip publicNetworkAccess to Disabled. The Container App keeps reaching Search via its private endpoint. Indexer setup (which needs the deployer's REST access) must have already run.
Storage account name. 3-24 chars, lowercase letters/numbers, globally unique.
Azure region.
Blob container name to create (default: rag-documents).
Principal ID of the AI Search service MSI to grant Storage Blob Data Reader.

Object ID of the user (or service principal) running the deploy. When set, granted Storage Blob Data Contributor on this account so they can upload PDFs via Azure Storage Explorer / portal without needing extra setup. Empty string skips the role assignment.
Principal type for deployerObjectId. "User" for interactive deploys, "ServicePrincipal" for CI/CD.

Network mode flag. When true, the storage account stays publicly accessible (publicNetworkAccess: Enabled — Azure does not let us combine PNA Disabled with IP rules) but the network ACL set defaultAction: Deny, plus `bypass: AzureServices` so the AI Search indexer (a trusted Microsoft service) and the deployer IP rule below are the only paths in.
Deployer public IP (IPv4) added to the storage network ACL in network mode so the deployer can upload PDFs via Storage Explorer / portal / AzCopy.

Additional IPv4 addresses (or CIDR ranges) allowed to reach this storage account in network mode. Use this to allow-list team-member workstation IPs so the team can upload documents via Storage Explorer / Portal / AzCopy without each user needing to be the deployer. Survives redeploys (out-of-band `az storage account network-rule add` would be wiped each time bicep runs).

Pass-2-only lockdown flag. When true (and networkEnabled), flips publicNetworkAccess to Disabled so all traffic flows exclusively through the private endpoint. The blob PE must already be provisioned (pass 1) and the AI Search indexer must reach storage via its Search-managed shared private link. IP rules are cleared automatically — they are incompatible with publicNetworkAccess: Disabled.
